Locations:	Capalaba, QLD, 4157
Full-Time:	Immediate start
Job Title:	Motor Mechanic (General)
Salary range;	$79,500 - $85,000 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date	30 days

About the Role
On behalf of our client – a specialist 4WD and off-road workshop that stocks parts for virtually every make and model – we are seeking an experienced Motor Mechanic (General). This role focuses on diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining a wide range of vehicles, with a strong emphasis on 4WD systems, heavy-duty suspension, driveline components, and engine performance. You will work in a well-equipped shop that handles everything from routine servicing to complex mechanical and electrical fault-finding on modern and classic 4x4s.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
• Detect and diagnose mechanical and electrical faults in engines, transmissions, steering, and 4WD-specific systems (e.g., transfer cases, differentials, locking hubs) using diagnostic computers and manual test equipment.
• Dismantle and remove engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms, and suspension components; inspect parts for wear or damage and refer to service manuals to determine repair or replacement needs.
• Repair or replace worn or defective parts – including clutches, brakes, CV joints, and turbochargers – and reassemble mechanical components to manufacturer specifications.
• Perform scheduled maintenance such as oil changes, filter replacements, lubrications, and engine tune-ups to ensure smooth running and compliance with emission regulations.
• Test and adjust repaired mechanical parts (e.g., wheel alignment, brake balance, engine timing) to verify proper performance and safety.
• Inspect vehicles for roadworthiness, issue certificates, or detail required repairs; may respond to breakdown calls for on-site assistance.

Requirements
• Trade qualification as a Motor Mechanic (General) or equivalent experience.
• Proven 1-year full-time experience in diagnostic skills with both conventional and computerized systems, especially on 4WD and light commercial vehicles.
• Ability to interpret service manuals, wiring diagrams, and parts catalogues accurately.
• Strong attention to detail, physical stamina, and a valid driver’s license (manual license preferred).
• Commitment to safety and quality workmanship.
• Relevant qualification to above field.

Apply now to join a team that works on all vehicles – from daily drivers to serious off-road rigs.
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience. Applications will be reviewed as received, therefore, please apply as soon as possible before the closing date.

Please note: All applications are confidential. We are acting as the exclusive recruitment agent for this role, and our client’s identity will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates.

About Us

Established in 1946, Teys Australia is a beef processing and food production business. We are best known for providing quality Aussie beef to customers here in Australia and around the world. 

With operations across 14 locations in Qld, NSW, Victoria, and South Australia, we are the second largest beef processor and exporter in Australia, employing over 5000 passionate people who drive our success, and bring their very best to work every day. 

Together, we focus on feeding people and enriching lives. Join us!?

About the Role
Teys Australia is seeking Skilled and Experienced Meat Processor Workers to join the processing team based at our Wagga Wagga processing site in New South Wales. The roles be responsible for

Production work/process line
Trimming, cutting, boning, slicing and/or slaughter
Cleaning and sterilising work areas and equipment
Operation of equipment and machinery
About You

You must have the following experience/skills:

Australian Citizen/Permanent Residency/Full Working Rights in Australia are essential
Willing to do a pre-employment medical check, including a drug and alcohol test
Q-Fever vaccinated 
Experience in meat processing plant as either boner, slicer or slaughter man and be AUSMEAT certified (or equivalent certification) 
Cert III (or higher) in Meat Processing
Be able to provide two professional references
 
What’s in it for You

Attractive hourly rate starting from $34.57 - $37.29
Access to a variety of discounts: meat products, health insurance and retailers
Service recognition awards 
Access to Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counselling services for you and your family
Opportunities to upskill and advance your career in meat production, maintenance, or management roles.
